subject: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@medops.com>, procurement@medops.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder

Hi Karen / MedOps procurement team —

Thanks again for the pilot conversation last week. Per our call, I put together a compact proposal for how we can structure the HIPAA pilot that includes: audit-log retention, an HSM seat (managed via SecureKey), and an optional US-only data residency activation.

High level asks from us so we can finalize numbers:
- Expected monthly inference throughput (avg tokens / month or API calls) for pilot (30–90 day pilot).
- Whether you require on-prem evidence handoff (SFTP) or encrypted drive transfer for audit logs.
- Target go/no-go decision date after pilot.

Draft commercial constructs I included in the attached spreadsheet (redwood_pilot_pricing_v1.xlsx):
1) Usage odometer: tiered per-token thresholds with retroactive credits at month-end. This reduces risk for you while unlocking a better unit price as volume accumulates.
2) Residency activation fee: one-time activation (amortizable over the first 12 months) for the US-residency enforcement and separate ingress routing.
3) HSM licensing: a managed seat paid monthly + a small BYOK-onboarding fee if MedOps brings its own keys. SecureKey provided an SLA stub (attached) we will finalize with them.
4) Evidence & proofing window: 90-day audit/eval window for quality regressions; evidence delivery milestones tied to partial credits if delays occur.

If you can confirm the throughput estimate and whether MedOps will bring keys or prefer SecureKey-managed keys, I’ll update the spreadsheet and a single-sheet commercial that includes a DocuSign-ready pilot SOW.

Next steps:/ I propose we sync Wed morning (PT) for 30 minutes to confirm metrics and sign-off on the pilot SOW.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_pilot_pricing_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@medops.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medops.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder

Jonas —

Thanks, this looks promising. A few clarifying Qs before we lock the Wed sync: 
1) Can you sketch how the "usage odometer" behaves if we spike in month 1 and drop in month 2? Any lookback or smoothing?
2) On the residency activation fee: do you amortize automatically, or do we need to request a credit schedule?
3) For evidence delivery, we may need a physical handoff for certain audit artifacts — is that captured as an extra line item or part of the activation fee?

Estimate for pilot volume: planning ~750k tokens/day peak, average ~250k tokens/day over the pilot (we'll confirm with engineering).

We'd prefer SecureKey-managed HSM for speed of onboarding, but Karen (security) asked whether BYOK would materially change recurring vs one-time costs.

CC'ing procurement to loop on PO/payment cadence.

- Karen Liu
Director, Security & Compliance, MedOps Inc
karen.liu@medops.com

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder

Jonas / Karen —

Thanks for the inclusion. Quick clarifications from SecureKey: 
- Managed HSM seat pricing is monthly and includes standard SLA (attached). Onboarding (BYOK key import) is a one-time activity (3–5 business days) and we charge a flat onboarding fee.
- BYOK has a small recurring license uplift (~10%) vs SecureKey-managed keys because of audit tooling we need to enable.
- Physical key escrow (if required) is a separate line item and will be priced based on the escrow vendor (we can provide estimates).

Attached: securekey_sla.pdf (standard SLA + onboarding notes). Happy to join the Wed call if helpful.

— Priya Rao

priya.rao@securekey.io
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medops.com, karen.liu@medops.com, sales@securekey.io
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder

Team —

Posting an annotated response to Karen's Qs so we can align before the Wed sync. Inline answers below (quoted):
> 1) Can you sketch how the "usage odometer" behaves if we spike in month 1 and drop in month 2? Any lookback or smoothing?

Answer: The odometer is cumulative for the billing period (monthly). Pricing tiers are retroactive for the month — if you cross a higher tier, the entire month's usage is re-priced at that tier and we apply a retroactive credit. For pilot only we can do a 3-month smoothing window for long-tail spikes (i.e., average the 3 months before applying the tiering) to protect you from front-loaded spikes.

> 2) On the residency activation fee: do you amortize automatically, or do we need to request a credit schedule?

Answer: We will amortize the activation fee by default over 12 months unless you request full upfront invoice. We'll surface amortization on the invoice and also show cumulative amortized credit in the billing export.

> 3) For evidence delivery, we may need a physical handoff for certain audit artifacts — is that captured as an extra line item or part of the activation fee?

Answer: Physical handoffs are out-of-scope for the activation fee and will be a billable line item tied to logistics (carrier, insured transport). We included an estimate in the attachments under "evidence_delivery_milestones.pdf" but will break it out on the SOW.

Next: Ben / Evelyn, want the discount ladder + credit math in the sheet to match this odometer behavior. Laura, can you confirm SOW language for evidence milestones? I'll pull a DocuSign-ready SOW once we all agree.

Jonas
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Structuring HIPAA + HSM pilot: usage odometer, residency activation, and discount ladder (internal math)

Jonas / Laura —

Proposal for the discount ladder that matches the odometer + pilot risk profile (numbers here are internal, will publish rounded tiers to customer):
- Tier A: 0–5M tokens/month — list price (pilot uplift applies: +8% because of evidence overhead)
- Tier B: 5M–15M tokens/month — 10% discount from list (retroactive monthly)
- Tier C: 15M–50M tokens/month — 18% discount from list (retroactive monthly)
- Velocity kicker: if cumulative tokens in first 60 days exceed 120% of forecast, auto-apply an additional 3% credit for months 2–4.

Residency activation: $40k one-time, amortized over 12 months (defaults to monthly amortization on invoice). If MedOps signs a 12-month commit > $X (we'll map to deal thresholds), we reduce activation to $25k and amortize over 6 months.

Evidence handoff: estimate $6k per physical transfer (includes packaging, insured carrier). Add as optional line item in SOW.

Notes on HSM: SecureKey-managed keys: monthly seat $2,500/seat; BYOK uplift +10% recurring; onboarding $4,000 one-time. Confirm with SecureKey and we'll reflect on the public sheet.

If ok, I'll produce a cleaned commercial and the SOW language.

— Ben
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@medops.com>, procurement@medops.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, sales@securekey.io
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final pilot offer and next steps (DocuSign + Wed sync recap)

Karen / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on your volume estimate (avg ~250k tokens/day, peak ~750k/day) and SecureKey's input, attached is an updated one-page commercial and SOW summary. Key bullets: 
- Pricing: we will apply the odometer tiering and retroactive monthly credits as described. With your forecast, you'll land in Tier B for the pilot and receive the associated per-token rates.
- Residency activation: reduced to $30k (special pilot concession) amortized over 12 months by default.
- HSM: SecureKey-managed seat at $2,500/month; BYOK uplift is ~10% if you choose to import keys.
- Evidence: physical handoff priced separately; we included an optional $6k estimate.
- Pilot term: 90 days; 30-day evaluation (proofing) with rolling evidence delivery milestones.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached DocuSign (docusign_medops_hsm_pilot.docx) and confirm signatures for pilot SOW. Link: https://app.docusign.com/medops/MEDOPS-2027-42
2) Confirm whether you want SecureKey-managed keys or BYOK so we can trigger onboarding.
3) Engineering: share a coarse token-per-call mapping so our billing team can map odometer thresholds to your API footprint.

If agreeable I'll route the DocuSign today and SecureKey will schedule onboarding upon signature. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call to resolve any last clarifications.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: docusign_medops_hsm_pilot.docx (docx), evidence_delivery_milestones.pdf (pdf)
